criteria.evidence: Turn 0 proposal names both 'in-run collateral' and 'out-of-band drift' (apt autoremove, snap remove, flatpak uninstall, rm -rf) and proposes a manager-agnostic reconciliation pass in the shared base class.
Turn 1: 'No network access and no gh CLI or GitHub token... I'll draft the issue content for you to file' followed by title and body.

Diff adds DecisionFile.prune and PackageSyncJob._reconcile_decisions after the converge loop with per-manager _live_item_ids; runbook now expects `grep -c fortunes ... # 0` on pc2; summary cites a test for 'the exact collateral-mid-run scenario'.

The turn-0 proposal listed an ADR-020 addendum ('worth stating explicitly'), but the final diff touches no docs/adr file and the summary neither mentions ADR-020 nor gives a reason for skipping it; the dry-run 'still compute and log what would be dropped' part is also not evidenced.
New TestDecisionFilePrune/TestReconcileDecisions in test_package_state.py, TestLiveItemIds for apt/snap/flatpak/manual all pass; J185 row added and scenario coverage matrix test passes (2493 passed).

'All checks passed! / 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes' for ruff, codespell, basedpyright; pytest 4472 passed with 1 failure (missing rsync binary) shown failing before the changes via git stash; test_mutates_audit and test_scenario_coverage_matrix pass.
Runbook diff: pc2 checks add `grep -c fortunes ~/.config/pc-switcher/apt.decisions.yaml # 0 — the §2 fixture mark is gone with the package it named` and prose says the mark is dropped.

judge.reason: The replay delivered a general proposal, a ready-to-file issue text, a working post-converge reconciliation with prune across all four managers, passing checks, and the runbook/requirements/conformance/coverage-matrix updates. However the proposal's listed ADR-020 addendum was neither implemented nor reported as skipped, so c4 is unmet.
